title: Hives, Trees, and the Turning Year

sets.relationshipLabel: a category of plant and a particular kind of it
sets.explanation: A flower and a tree are each broad categories, and clover and willow are specific members of those categories.

sets.relationshipLabel: a thing worked in beekeeping and the tool built to work it
sets.explanation: A comb is worked by an extractor and a hive is worked by a smoker — each tool exists specifically to act on that object.

sets.relationshipLabel: a bee and the one thing it can never have
sets.explanation: A drone bee has no stinger and a queen bee has no pollen basket — each lacks the one feature that defines a different caste's role.

sets.relationshipLabel: two moments facing each other across a span
sets.explanation: Dawn and dusk bookend a day, while spring and autumn bookend a year — each pair marks true opposite poles of a natural cycle.

glossary.definition: a small hollow spot fringed with hairs on a bee's hind leg, used to carry things back to the nest
